scope: Post-inference annotation diagnosis of an existing 36-frame pilot; not new footage or an independent accuracy study.
method: All 36 raw frames inspected in source contact sheets, followed by all 12 knife-label overlays. Five ambiguous knife frames also inspected individually at native size. Original notes and aggregate results were known; this is not a blinded review. No model prediction overlays were used to edit labels.

ambiguity_diagnostic.interpretation: Post-hoc diagnostic of existing predictions, partitioned by the original pre-inference ambiguity flags; not a new accuracy estimate or corrected evaluation.

conclusion: Localization uncertainty remains, but the weakness is not confined to flagged labels: none of the six originally unflagged knife frames matched. Preserve the pilot result and report generalization limitations.
human_review_status: No human review has been performed or simulated. A person may adjudicate the six flagged bounds using the supplied raw/label sheets before using these as reference-quality labels.
